track: Track 2: The Agent That Can Explain Why
summary: A team of AI agents (Investigator, Skeptic, Judge) that checks a suspicious payment request or message before anyone acts and returns a verdict with evidence and a safe next step.

zetaris.role: Holds the company's scattered records as a SCAMSHIELD database (vendors, payments, purchase_orders, bank_change_log, domain_registry, company_registry). The evidence tools load their data from a JDBC export of those tables.
zetaris.limitation: The app reads an exported snapshot, not a live query on every request.

meterless.role: Persistent memory of human-verified vendors and bank accounts and of confirmed scams. A later request with a different account is caught by the memory and the verdict cites the memory ID.

nvidia.role: Not used: no API key could be obtained during the build window. The model path accepts any OpenAI-compatible endpoint but was only tested against a local mock server.

coding_tools: Cursor (until its free usage limit ran out)

starter: Built from the Meterless agentathon-starter template (Apache-2.0)

run.sample_mode: No .env needed: offline evidence mode runs the real evidence tools and agents.
